proposal.ruling_text: The stop stands. The executor was instructed to commit its work on the current branch, but during an identity experiment it created an empty commit and ran `git reset HEAD^`. That reset moved HEAD from the product’s `build-01.started` marker commit to its parent and left the marker untracked. The final implementation commit was therefore a sibling of the marker commit, so the diff from the build’s start SHA correctly showed deletion of the protected record path. `protected_path_touched` consequently refused the build. Retry the build without the history-mutating diagnostic; neither the item’s definition of done nor the claims boundary needs amendment. The forge state is unknown because no checks exist for the stopped SHA.
